name: Alta Group d.o.o. Beograd
note: Sole (100%) shareholder of Alta banka a.d. per the bank's audited 2025 annual report, which names ALTA Group doo Beograd; the bank's 2024 capital increase was bought by then-sole-shareholder Alta Pay Group d.o.o. (Nova ekonomija, 6 Aug 2024). Press (Nova ekonomija) identify businessman Davor Macura as owner of Alta Pay.
